What is the difference between /, // and % ?

Supplied answer
/ is true division and always returns a float (7 / 2 = 3.5). // is floor division and returns the quotient without
the decimal part (7 // 2 = 3). % is modulus and returns the remainder (7 % 2 = 1). ** is the power operator
(2 ** 3 = 8).
